legal.title: Legal notice & privacy
legal.intro: MyLloguer is a non-profit classifieds platform for private rentals and shared flats across Spain, run by Global Shapers Valencia.
legal.dataBody: We only process what the service needs: your listing content (including the WhatsApp number or contact link, which is public), your email (private, only used to send you the management link) and an encrypted identifier of that link. No account is needed. We do not sell data to third parties. You can delete your listing at any time from your management link.
legal.contentBody: Listings are the sole responsibility of their publishers. We moderate listings before publication but cannot guarantee their accuracy.
legal.contactBody: For any question you can write to us at valencia.globalshapers@gmail.com.
